summary: A single focused owner route proved indexed interaction pruning, semantic cache reuse, deterministic work exhaustion, and native/Fable report parity without running the repository aggregate.
The first focused verifier depended on warm SIR.Tools assets and failed in a detached checkout; explicit tool restore plus locked project restores made the same route pass with an empty NuGet cache.
cost: one failed hosted candidate and one detached cold rerun

summary: Optimizing a mutation gate from project runs to owner-assembly builds preserved functional evidence and timing but initially moved the observable build boundary without moving its per-subject trace identities or canonical inventory.
